name: WayriCAD Constraint Studio
description: Visual constraint worksheets, matrices, layout scope and reviewed project rules.
description_full: Constraint Studio with a BOM Studio-style native desktop WebView: editable constraint worksheets, all 34 rule forms, linked scope preview, A/B priority traces, clearance matrices, reusable sets, netclass dimensions and reviewed export. Original BGA, engineering, team and native help workspaces remain available. Saved-project staging with offline apply; KiCad 10 testing target. Layer routing profiles persist native per-layer widths and differential gaps, with stackup fingerprints and reviewed DRC limits.
